conditions.evidence: FDG-PET/CT Staging of Head and Neck Cancer
conditions.label: head and neck cancer

output.population: Head and neck cancer patients with a clinically N0 neck undergoing pathologic sampling of neck lymph nodes.
output.summary: Multicenter trial collection (ACRIN 6685) assessing the negative predictive value of FDG-PET/CT for the clinically N0 neck against pathologic lymph node sampling, and its potential to change neck treatment.
